0.msg: ...You must not want to take the pill yet. Do you not trust me, Russellon? As someone who's been in Alcadno longer than you, I thought I was being nothing but a good mentor to you...\r\n(Go to #bLab - Area B-1#k and consume the medicine on Russellon's Desk.)

0.0:
Oh! You really came back.
You know, Newcomer, you've really worked hard despite being so new. You've helped me a lot, and I really appreciate it...As a token of thanks, I prepared a small gift for you. Will you accept it?

yes.0: Hahaha... Good, then I want you to go to #b#m261020200##k. On top of the desk lay some pills that I have recently concocted, so take it... Oh, and since I am eager to see the effects of it, I want you to take it, and then come back to me. #bYou must take the pills first, and then come back#k.

no.0: Did you just say no? ...I can't believe you declined my well-intentioned present. I, #p2111009#, am very hurt by this...

QuestInfo.name: [Magatia's Secret] Life Alchemy, and the Missing Alchemist
QuestInfo.0: Out of the blue, Alcadno's #p2111009# told me he wanted to reward me for helping him out with various favors... something doesn't seem right, but I'll just think of it as a positive event. I should go see #b#p2111009##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2111009# seemed grateful for my help, and asked me to take a pill that he left for me at the top of the table in #bLab - Area B-1#k. He also asked me to come down and see him again before its effect wears off. What's this about? Am I his lab-rat?
QuestInfo.2: I knew it! I knew the medicine was dangerous. Fortunately, I was able to receive an antidote, but this is crazy! According to Russellon, the experiment he conducted was something he did with the #bmissing alchemist#k, a friend of his. The missing alchemist must have worked on something like changing the human's body form...
